texts.d417e9c8cefa: The aim of our study is to examine the genetic and environmental determinants of risk of cardiovascular disease (myocardial infarction, angina, need for coronary surgery, stroke, abdominal aortic aneurysms, peripheral arterial disease etc).  NPHS II is a prospective cohort of 3,000 healthy middle aged men recruited from 9 general practices throughout the UK who have now been followed for more than 15 years.  The prospective nature of the study allows us to examine the impact of risk factors before a disease event has occurred.
